title: First-principles study of M4AlC3 (M = Ti, Zr) MAX phases under hydrostatic pressure: material design for industrial applications
content:

The structural, mechanical, electronic, optical and thermal properties of MAX phases M4AlC3 (M = Ti, Zr) and their potential applications were examined at ambient and hydrostatic pressure through DFT simulation.
